subAreas.name: Collapsed Crypt Ledge
subAreas.description: A dry stone shelf behind a fallen lintel where old grave-robbers hid brass lanterns and bronze offerings.

subAreas.name: Sunken Peat Shrine
subAreas.description: Half-drowned boundary stones circling a quiet pool where bitter herbs and pale stalkers gather.

subAreas.name: Glass-Sap Hollow
subAreas.description: A windless bowl of crystalized tree-trunks humming softly with trapped resonance.

subAreas.name: Flooded Seam Gallery
subAreas.description: A narrow adit cut into wet slate where forgotten mining tools and iron-armored constructs still wait.

encounters.label: Broken Road
encounters.prose: Beyond a ridge of wet heather, you spot cracked flagstones winding north toward a ruined stone road.

encounters.label: Timber Palisade
encounters.prose: Peat smoke and lantern-glow mark a fortified timber keep perched above the marshland.

encounters.label: Mound Trail
encounters.prose: An overgrown sheep-track leads toward a moss-covered stone burial mound weeping pale water.

encounters.label: Reed Causeway
encounters.prose: Sunken wooden planks mark a treacherous path across steaming grey peat marshes.

encounters.label: Dead Orchard
encounters.prose: You map a narrow ridge overlooking rows of drowned apple trees hung with bone-lanterns.

encounters.label: Silk Cavern
encounters.prose: A hidden chalk stair descends beneath the reeds toward glowing subterranean cistern halls.

encounters.label: Stone Trees
encounters.prose: Pale, petrified trunks rise like glass pillars beyond the northern fog.

encounters.label: Steam Fissures
encounters.prose: Warm sulfur mist guides your compass toward jagged black glass trenches.

encounters.label: Flooded Gate
encounters.prose: Half-submerged dwarf stonework marks the entrance to an ancient flooded forge hall.

encounters.label: Salt Galleries
encounters.prose: A collapsed hillside reveals dry, salt-crusted burial arches beneath the ridge.

encounters.label: Slate Pit
encounters.prose: Rusted winch-chains silhouette a stepped black slate quarry pit in the distance.

encounters.label: High Ruin
encounters.prose: A shattered stone watchtower perches atop the highest crag overlooking the valley.

encounters.label: Drowned Spire
encounters.prose: Far in the mist, a half-sunken bronze bell-tower tolls once through heavy fog.

encounters.label: Hound Ambush
encounters.prose: Low growls rattle in the wet brush as a gaunt cinder-mouthed beast stalks into view.

encounters.label: Wandering Tinker
encounters.prose: A hooded tinker pushing a squeaking handcart halts by your trail-markers and opens a oilcloth pack.

encounters.label: Lost Satchel
encounters.prose: Half-buried beside a milestone, a rotted leather satchel still holds dry bandages.

encounters.label: Ash Overlook
encounters.prose: From a windswept granite shelf you watch grey rain sweep across the drowned valley floor.

encounters.label: Bronze Marker
encounters.prose: A small bronze bell hangs from a dead hawthorn branch, its clapper wrapped tight in waxed linen.

encounters.label: Quiet Scrub
encounters.prose: You beat through wet scrub and cold ash for two hours without crossing a living soul.

encounters.label: Road Cutthroat
encounters.prose: A ragged highwayman steps from behind an overturned wagon with rust-flecked steel.

encounters.label: Cart Salvage
encounters.prose: Inside a splintered supply chest you find a jar of amber resin and scattered coins.

encounters.label: Broken Milestones
encounters.prose: Mossy stone markers lean sideways along the sunken flagstones, pointing toward older roads.

encounters.label: Hidden Ledge
encounters.prose: Behind a slipped lintel stone you uncover a narrow dry shelf above the barrow ditch.

encounters.label: Crypt Stair
encounters.prose: Clearing wet brambles reveals a sunken stone stair descending beneath the Weeping Barrow.

encounters.label: Barrow Stalker
encounters.prose: Pale roots crackle behind a stone pillar as a spore-choked figure lurches forward.

encounters.label: Ledge Guardian
encounters.prose: An armored husk rattling with bronze charms rises from a stone alcove.

encounters.label: Silver-Ash Oil
encounters.prose: Tucked behind a collapsed urn sits an untouched vial of silver-ash weapon oil.

encounters.label: Peat Shrine
encounters.prose: Parting tall marsh reeds reveals a ring of half-drowned boundary stones around a clear spring.

encounters.label: Sluice Gate
encounters.prose: Beneath a willow root you spot rusted iron sluice-bars leading into flooded cistern vaults.

encounters.label: Chitin Lurker
encounters.prose: Bubbles break the black peat water as a pale-shelled ambush predator lunges.

encounters.label: Shrine Offering
encounters.prose: On a dry plinth above the dark water rests a stoppered purge draught.

encounters.label: Orchard Hound
encounters.prose: Bone-lanterns clack overhead as an ember-jawed beast splashes through the flooded rows.

encounters.label: Orchard Herbs
encounters.prose: Silver-veined marsh leaves sprout thick along a dry stone wall.

encounters.label: Glass Hollow
encounters.prose: Between fused crystal trunks, a narrow crack opens into a resonant hollow.

encounters.label: Choir Sentinel
encounters.prose: A bronze-masked figure steps noiselessly from behind a petrified trunk.

encounters.label: Silver Writ
encounters.prose: Wedged inside a split crystal root lies an intact Ash-Text scroll.

encounters.label: Kiln Shaft
encounters.prose: Warm air rises from an iron ladder bolted down into a collapsed furnace shaft.

encounters.label: Vent Stalker
encounters.prose: Ash-crusted predators dart out from a steaming obsidian trench.

encounters.label: Salt Patrol
encounters.prose: Heavy bronze bells echo down the salt-white corridor as two figures close in.

encounters.label: Altar Cache
encounters.prose: Behind a salt-sealed niche you uncover a vial of amber draught.

encounters.label: Seam Gallery
encounters.prose: Behind a derailed ore-cart you spot a braced timber adit cut deep into wet slate.

encounters.label: Slate Construct
encounters.prose: Gears grind beneath wet stone as a heavy forge-warden lumbers across the terrace.

encounters.label: Guard Locker
encounters.prose: Inside an iron locker sits a bossed buckler wrapped in oiled cloth.

encounters.label: Tower Guard
encounters.prose: Armed deserters and bell-bound zealots block the broken parapet stair.

encounters.label: Cold Beacon
encounters.prose: The stone brazier atop the tower holds dead silver ash that still hums softly in the wind.

encounters.label: Choir Descent
encounters.prose: Beneath the cracked bronze bell, flooded steps spiral down into the Choir-Pit.

encounters.label: Belfry Guard
encounters.prose: Two bronze-masked zealots step out of the knee-deep water with raised censers.
